testnet.name: portaldot-v3-testnet
testnet.note: Verified live 2026-10-22: eth_chainId=0x190f1ca9, BN254 precompiles 0x06/0x07/0x08 OK, raw EVM bytecode + PUSH0 OK, EVM values scaled x10^4 to 18 decimals (native 14), existential deposit 0.1 tPOT. Run `npm run preflight` to re-verify.

mainnet.name: portaldot-mainnet
mainnet.note: LEGACY Portaldot mainnet (wss://mainnet.portaldot.io, explorer portalscan) exposes NO EVM (eth_chainId => method not found). The V3 runtime with EVM support runs on 'v3live' — see that entry and docs/MAINNET.md.

v3live.name: portaldot-v3-live
v3live.note: PortaldotV3 Live (real POT), found 2026-10-23 as the node-console default: same V3 runtime with pallet-revive (allowEVMBytecode=true, revive.chainId=780780777, nativeToEthRatio=10^4) but NO public eth-rpc endpoint was found, so EVM-RPC deployment is refused here. Not confirmed by official docs as the production mainnet — confirm with Portaldot, run a trusted-setup ceremony and get an independent audit before any real-funds use (docs/MAINNET.md).
